shows.title: The Rookie
shows.description: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

shows.title: Tracker
shows.description: Lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw roams the country as a reward seeker, using his tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

shows.title: Blue Bloods
shows.description: A New York crime drama focusing on a multigenerational family of cops that includes the city's police commissioner, his two sons and his retired father.
